note: 只保存本批87新词的逐义项例句。可追溯ETS/Oxford原句，其余null。中文为自译。

meanings: 抹去，遮没，使痕迹无法辨认
使从记忆或认识中完全消失

examples.en: The building was completely obliterated by the bomb.
examples.zh: 那栋建筑被炸弹彻底摧毁了。

examples.en: The snow had obliterated their footprints.
examples.zh: 雪把他们的脚印完全掩盖了。

examples.en: Everything that happened that night was obliterated from his memory.
examples.zh: 那晚发生的一切都从他的记忆中消失了。

meanings: 繁殖旺盛的，产量丰富的

examples.en: The effort honors Gordon, one of America’s most prolific and thoughtful scholars.
examples.zh: 这项举措向戈登致敬，他是美国成果最为丰硕、思想最为深刻的学者之一。

source.locator: PDF 第 10 页，ETS Creates Edmund W. Gordon Chair for Policy Evaluation & Research；ETS 刊物原文，非 GRE 试题

examples.en: The kiwi fruit is known for its prolific yield and good export price.
examples.zh: 猕猴桃以产量丰富和出口价格良好而闻名。

meanings: 禁令，限制（尤指暂缓发布信息）
不由自主的，不受意志控制的
长期持续的，经久耐用的
恳切的劝告，郑重的请求
正式而隆重的，依仪式举行的
捐赠基金，捐赠的财产或收入
泥沼，沼泽（尤指酸性的泥炭湿地）
正统的，符合公认教义或传统的
可疑的，不可靠的（尤指品行或诚实程度）
未必属实或有价值的；结果难料的

examples.en: I was rather dubious about the whole idea.
examples.zh: 我对整个想法颇有疑虑。

examples.en: The man who sold it to him was known to be of dubious character.
examples.zh: 卖给他那件东西的人以品行可疑而为人所知。

meanings: 刺激物，促使人行动的因素
不能胜任的，力所不及的
耐寒的，能适应恶劣环境的

examples.en: These policies are inimical to the interests of society.
examples.zh: 这些政策有损社会利益。

meanings: 无精打采，缺乏兴趣或动力
超凡脱俗的，仿佛非尘世的
（印度教等的）精神导师，宗教导师
使掌权，使处于最高地位
削弱，使失去活力或意志
细致严谨的，一丝不苟的

examples.en: He was scrupulous in all his business dealings.
examples.zh: 他在所有商业往来中都恪守诚信。

examples.en: You must be scrupulous about hygiene when you're preparing a baby's feed.
examples.zh: 给婴儿准备食物时，你必须格外注意卫生。

meanings: 兴趣或阅读范围广泛的，广泛涉猎的

examples.en: She has always been an omnivorous reader.
examples.zh: 她一直是一位阅读范围极广的读者。

source.locator: 兴趣广泛义项的原例句

meanings: 综合性的，包含多个事项的

examples.en: The factory is due to be demolished next year.
examples.zh: 这座工厂计划明年拆除。

examples.en: A recent book has demolished this theory.
examples.zh: 最近出版的一本书推翻了这一理论。

examples.en: The children demolished their burgers and chips.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快吃光了汉堡和薯条。

examples.en: It is the story of a military coup which brings a brutal despot to power.
examples.zh: 故事讲的是一场把残暴独裁者扶上台的军事政变。

meanings: （事物）变化迅速且难以预测的

examples.en: Emily's mercurial temperament made her difficult to live with.
examples.zh: 埃米莉喜怒无常，很难与她共同生活。

source.locator: 情绪变化无常义项原例句

examples.en: Advertising is a mercurial business.
examples.zh: 广告业是一个变化莫测的行业。

source.locator: 事物变化无常义项原例句

examples.en: He has acted in obedience to the law.
examples.zh: 他的行为遵循了法律。

meanings: 幸存的一小部分人或群体

examples.en: The institution is a remnant from the past.
examples.zh: 这个机构是过去遗留下来的产物。

source.locator: 残余部分义项的 Extra Examples

meanings: 提交的文件、作品或申请

examples.en: They bombed the town into submission.
examples.zh: 他们轰炸这座城镇，迫使它屈服。

examples.en: They prepared a report for submission to the council.
examples.zh: 他们准备了一份报告，以提交给议会。

examples.en: Late submissions will not be marked.
examples.zh: 迟交的作业不予评分。

meanings: 厚颜无耻的，肆无忌惮的

examples.en: They showed a brazen disregard for the law.
examples.zh: 他们肆无忌惮地无视法律。

meanings: 厚着脸皮坚持，硬撑（常用 brazen it out）

examples.en: Now that everyone knew the truth, the only thing to do was to brazen it out.
examples.zh: 既然大家都知道了真相，就只能厚着脸皮硬撑下去。

source.locator: brazen it out 惯用语原例句

examples.en: The budding young star is now hot property in Hollywood.
examples.zh: 这位初露头角的年轻明星如今在好莱坞炙手可热。

examples.en: The incident was used as a pretext for intervention in the area.
examples.zh: 这起事件被用作干预该地区事务的借口。

examples.en: The findings are consonant with other research.
examples.zh: 这些发现与其他研究相符。

meanings: （恶行、违规等）公然且恶劣的，明目张胆的

examples.en: He showed a flagrant disregard for anyone else's feelings.
examples.zh: 他公然无视其他所有人的感受。

meanings: 似是而非的，貌似有理而实际错误的
华而不实的，外表诱人而有欺骗性的
大量，许多（常用 a slew of）

examples.en: This year has seen a whole slew of novels set in Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 今年出现了大量以香港为背景的小说。

examples.en: The car skidded and slewed sideways.
examples.zh: 汽车打滑，猛地向侧面滑去。

examples.en: He behaved like a petulant child and refused to cooperate.
examples.zh: 他像个闹脾气的孩子，拒绝配合。

meanings: 消除或缓解（恐惧、疑虑等）

examples.en: The government is keen to allay the public's fears.
examples.zh: 政府急于消除公众的恐惧。

examples.en: Blood was beginning to seep through the bandages.
examples.zh: 血开始透过绷带渗出来。

meanings: 令人厌烦的，令人恼火的

examples.en: I found the restrictions irksome.
examples.zh: 我觉得这些限制很烦人。

meanings: 回报，以同样的行为或感情回应

examples.en: Her passion for him was not reciprocated.
examples.zh: 她对他的热情没有得到回应。

examples.en: Most decent people abhor corruption in government.
examples.zh: 大多数正派的人都憎恶政府中的腐败。

examples.en: He seems to regard the interests of the state as coterminous with the interests of the party in government.
examples.zh: 他似乎把国家利益与执政党的利益视为一致。

examples.en: The decision does seem a little heartless.
examples.zh: 这个决定确实显得有些无情。

meanings: （思想、情绪或表达）混乱不清的

examples.en: Paris was besieged for four months and forced to surrender.
examples.zh: 巴黎遭围困四个月，被迫投降。

examples.en: The radio station was besieged with calls from angry listeners.
examples.zh: 愤怒听众的大量来电使广播电台应接不暇。

meanings: 把日期写得早于实际日期

examples.en: The paint was brittle with age.
examples.zh: 油漆因年久而变脆。

examples.en: ‘Not at all,’ she said in a brittle voice, avoiding his eye.
examples.zh: “一点也不，”她用尖厉的声音说，避开了他的目光。

meanings: 在某种条件下蓬勃发展，因…而兴奋

examples.en: These animals rarely thrive in captivity.
examples.zh: 这些动物被圈养时很少能生长良好。

examples.en: New businesses thrive in this area.
examples.zh: 新企业在这一地区蓬勃发展。

meanings: 安慰剂（无特定治疗活性、用于安慰或试验对照的制剂）

examples.en: Half of the people taking part in the experiment were given a placebo.
examples.zh: 参加实验的人中有一半接受了安慰剂。

examples.en: She had been prescribed antibiotics to treat a chest infection.
examples.zh: 医生给她开了抗生素来治疗胸部感染。

meanings: （象征责任或权力的）衣钵，职责

examples.en: I had to dismantle the engine in order to repair it.
examples.zh: 为了修理发动机，我不得不把它拆开。

examples.en: The government was in the process of dismantling the state-owned industries.
examples.zh: 政府正在逐步拆解国有工业体系。

examples.en: He was always very discreet about his love affairs.
examples.zh: 他谈到自己的情事时总是十分谨慎。

examples.en: They accepted the offer with alacrity.
examples.zh: 他们欣然接受了这个提议。

meanings: 侵犯他人权益（尤指商业权益）
相互冲突的，不能同时成立的

examples.en: There were several competing accounts of what actually happened that night.
examples.zh: 关于那晚实际发生的事，有几种互不一致的说法。

examples.en: Five competing teams will vie for the trophy.
examples.zh: 五支参赛队伍将争夺奖杯。

examples.en: The report is a masterpiece of brevity.
examples.zh: 这份报告堪称简洁表达的典范。

examples.en: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.
examples.zh: 女性劳动者占劳动力的大多数。

examples.en: Does such an activity constitute a criminal offence?
examples.zh: 这样的活动算不算刑事犯罪？
